kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Classical Syriac ܡܫܚܩܘܢܝܐ (məšaḥ-qōnyā, literally “ointment of ashes”), from ܡܫܚܐ (mešḥā, “salve, unguent”) + ܩܘܢܝܐ (qōnyā, “ashes in general; lye from ashes and quicklime; glaze”) borrowed from Ancient Greek κονία (konía, “dust, ashes, scilicet potash, saltwort”).
s: Borrowed from Classical Syriac ܡܫܚܩܘܢܝܐ (məšaḥ-qōnyā, literally “ointment of ashes”)
Ancient Greek κονία (konía, “dust, ashes, scilicet potash, saltwort”)
g: calcium silicate, dross or slags from glass
